set.body:
Source: library-packaging review.

Problem:
the repository lacks a LICENSE, complete publishing metadata, automated release publishing, and binary-compatibility enforcement. CI still advertises compiler lanes inconsistent with the Scala 3.7.4 baseline, and warnings are not fatal.

Acceptance:
- Add the chosen LICENSE plus licenses, developers, homepage/scmInfo, organization, and artifact metadata.
- Adopt sbt-typelevel or an explicit equivalent for CI-fatal warnings, signing/publication, and release automation.
- Configure MiMa or the appropriate Scala 3 public-API compatibility gate consistent with early-semver.
- Make Scala 3.7.4 the actual CI/publication baseline everywhere and remove stale 3.3.8/3.8.4 lanes.
- Exercise publishLocal/package/worker artifacts in the release gate and document the release procedure.
set.title: P6f.18: Establish publication and binary-compatibility infrastructure
